hand.title: Daily Hand

events.text: Your cards — K, Q. You raised before the cards were dealt. Your opponent called.
Flop — 10, Queen, 7. You bet. Your opponent just called.
Turn — 10. You bet again. Your opponent raised you.

wrongReasons: 7 5 doesn't benefit from the turn card the way the correct hand does. A player holding only two pair wouldn't have the confidence to raise on that street.
K 5 doesn't benefit from the turn card the way the correct hand does. A player holding only one pair wouldn't have the confidence to raise on that street.
9 Q doesn't benefit from the turn card the way the correct hand does. A player holding only two pair wouldn't have the confidence to raise on that street.
hand.explanation:
Answer: 8 10

Your opponent flopped a full house and slow-played the flop, calling to disguise their strength. Once the pot was big enough they raised the turn and shoved the river — a classic trap with a monster hand.
